title: AI helps solve at least one Millennium Prize Problem
description: At least one of the six Millennium Prize Problems that were open at the forecast date: Birch and Swinnerton-Dyer conjecture, Hodge conjecture, Navier-Stokes existence and smoothness, P versus NP, Riemann hypothesis, or Yang-Mills existence and mass gap. Poincaré is excluded because it was already solved at the forecast date.
definition: At least one correct complete solution meeting an original Clay mathematical statement, first publicly available by the deadline, with an identifiable new AI-contributed mathematical argument or proof step incorporated in that solution. Later validation may establish correctness; the prize award need not precede the deadline.
